artworks.title: View of the Crystal Mountains, Brazil
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with gentle hills stretching into the distance. The horizon is positioned high in the composition with softly painted clouds above the peaks of the hills. The brushstrokes are smooth, creating a sense of tranquility. The color palette includes earthy greens and browns with pastel tones in the sky. There are structures near us, possibly tipis, partially obscured by the terrain.

artworks.title: Return from a Turtle Hunt - Connibo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people standing, with varied poses. They have distinct facial features, dark hair with feathers, minimal clothing, and ornaments. Some hold objects like a paddle or a spear. Some balance baskets or pots on their heads. In the foreground is a wooden structure with a thatched roof. The background has lush green foliage, and additional figures can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Wild Cattle Grazing on the Pampa del Sacramento
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated position, looking over a wide plains area. The horizon is low, meeting a range of hills in the distance. The terrain and animals are detailed with realistic brushstrokes in earthy tones. The sky is blue with pink and gray clouds, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Spearing by Moonlight - Chaco
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a waterscape with indigenous individuals in a canoe. The scene features dense foliage, tall trees, smooth brushstrokes, deep blues and greens, and a reflective water surface.

artworks.title: Driving the Pampas for Wild Cattle - Connibo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high horizon line, showcasing a grassy plain under a soft sky. Figures on horseback are dispersed across the scene, with fluid brushstrokes depicting movement in the grass and sky. The color palette is mainly earth tones, greens, rust, and ochre, set against a pale blue sky.

artworks.title: A Small Orejona Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a river flowing through a dense jungle. A boat with a thatched roof is on the water, near a riverbank where people in red clothing are gathered, some on the boat and some on the shore. The scene includes makeshift structures along the sloping bank. The brushstrokes are deliberate, with naturalistic details in the foliage and stylized figures. The color palette is earthy with pops of red.

artworks.title: An Omagua Village - Boat Sketch
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank scene with a canoe on the water and various figures gathered on the bank. Small figures are engaged in different activities, surrounded by a forest in the background. The painting is detailed with smooth brushstrokes, primarily using earthy and natural tones. The artwork is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: A Mura Encampment - Boat Sketch
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people engaged in various activities near a riverbank. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing lush rainforest vegetation dominating the upper part of the scene. A cluster of tent-like structures is positioned to the left, with people around them. Smooth and detailed brushwork captures the dense foliage and the color palette is mainly rich greens with accents of earth tones. A canoe with figures is visible on the river to the right.

artworks.title: A Mayoruna Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene along the bank of a river. A long boat is near the water's edge with individuals onboard, with smoke rising from it. Other figures are on a grassy area, possibly gathering or at an event. In the distance, there is a settlement with huts among greenery. The horizon has tall trees against a blue sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing clear figures and landscape. The color palette includes greens, browns, and blue, creating a harmonious natural scene.

artworks.title: A Yahua Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, a boat with people on it, individuals in red attire on the riverbank, huts on a grassy clearing, and a dense jungle with towering palms in the background. The color palette consists of green shades, red garments, and a blue sky.

artworks.title: View of the Shore of the Amazon - Boat Sketch
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a dense line of green foliage along the horizon. There are two boats on the water, one closer and bigger than the other. The brushwork is smooth, depicting land, sky, and water realistically. The color palette includes blues, greens, earth tones, and some muted reds. The sky displays light cloud formations.

artworks.title: Encampment of Cocomas - Looking Ashore
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a view of a dense green landscape with tall trees, large plants, and two rustic huts with thatched roofs nestled among the vegetation. In the foreground, a group of people is gathered, depicted with dark tones that contrast against the verdant surroundings. The color palette consists of various shades of green, with hints of earthy browns. The brushstrokes are smooth and blended, creating a realistic portrayal of the foliage and adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Tapuya Encampment
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a forest scene with dancers and a tent. Figures are dancing in the foreground on green grass, with each figure positioned expressively. More figures are gathered near a tent, and in the background, dense trees fill the scene. A serene body of water is visible through the clearing, surrounded by greenery.

artworks.title: Mauhees Encampment
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with a lush and verdant landscape. The horizon is partially obscured by the trees, and a body of water is visible on the left. The brushstrokes are meticulous, detailing the foliage and figures in the scene. The color palette is mainly rich greens with earth tones for the huts and skin tones. People, possibly indigenous, are engaged in various activities, surrounded by huts nestled in the forest. Thick borders frame the scene.

artworks.title: A Lagoon of the Upper Amazon
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a lush, tropical landscape with dense green foliage. The vegetation varies in size and form, with large leaves contrasting against softer background vegetation. The brushwork is gentle, creating a humid jungle atmosphere. In the foreground is a still water surface surrounded by greenery and flowers. The color palette consists of deep greens with splashes of red, blue, and yellow. In the distance, various shades of green add depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Indian Camp in the Forest
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays a jungle scene with dense vegetation, human figures, and huts in the distance. The foliage is thick, creating a green wall with a high horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing layers of leaves and branches. The color palette consists of shades of green. Red-hued figures are seen closer to us, engaging in various activities.

artworks.title: Painting the Tobos Chief
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image captures a scenic view inside a circular frame. The perspective is across a river or channel towards a settlement in a lush, tropical landscape. The horizon is in the upper third, featuring tall palm trees and dense foliage. The brushstrokes create a soft, blended style, with details in the vegetation. The color palette is predominantly green and blue, with touches of brown for structures and people. A canoe with a thatched covering is in the foreground on the water, being paddled by a person in red. A group of people in red stand on the riverbank, near small thatched huts. The sky has a light blue color with pinkish clouds.

artworks.title: A Small Tobos Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated perspective. A row of leaning palm trees forms the horizon just above the center of the image. Below, multiple people and animals are gathered on a grassy area, with a simple thatched roof structure visible in the distance. The background is filled with swaying palm trees against the sky. The painting employs soft brushstrokes and a color palette dominated by pale blues for the sky and soft greens and earth tones for the landscape and figures.

artworks.title: Ignis Fatuus, Rio Uruguay
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a night scene in a dense and shadowy forest. A faintly illuminated path is visible running horizontally through the scene. Dark silhouettes of trees and foliage surround the path, leading to a strip of warm light shining through the trees. The horizon is obscured by the densely packed trees, creating a continuous dark mass. The artist uses blended brushstrokes to create subtle transitions between light and shadow, adding depth. The color palette consists of deep greens and blacks with touches of muted oranges and yellows where the light breaks through, creating contrast. Softly rendered brushstrokes blur the boundaries of form, enhancing the scene's depth and contrast.

artworks.title: An Alligator's Nest
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Entrance to a Lagoon, Shore of the Amazon
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting shows a scene with dense jungle vegetation viewed from a riverbank. The horizon is low, defined by the water meeting the greenery. The vegetation is depicted with intricate brushwork, portraying a tropical environment with a green color palette. A canoe with two figures is seen on the water, while dense foliage adds depth in the background.

artworks.title: A Connibo Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting features a view from a shaded, leafy area looking out towards an open landscape. Tall trees with cascading vines and dense foliage dominate the scene close to us. Beyond the trees, the horizon is set low and appears to be a blend of various shades of green and muted pastels. The brushstrokes used to depict the trees and foliage are soft and sweeping, creating a lush, textured effect. The color palette is rich in greens, with touches of earth tones in the structures on the right, and patches of soft blues in the sky just above the horizon.

artworks.title: Connibos Starting for Wild Horses
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a grassland, with horsemen in red attire at the bottom left corner. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky filled with clouds in shades of gray and pink against a blue background. The grassland extends into the distance with hints of red and blue patches. The color palette consists of earthy greens and blues.

artworks.title: Grand Lavoir, Pampa del Sacramento
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting features a landscape with a low horizon and a group of distant hills in the background. The sky above shows rich hues of oranges, yellows, pinks, and hints of blue. The brushstrokes create a smooth texture. Several figures on horseback are shown in the foreground on vast grassy plains. The color palette transitions from earthy greens to warm sky tones.
